parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) One molecule of butane reacts with one molecule of chlorine in the presence of ultraviolet light. During the reaction, one hydrogen atom in butane is replaced by one chlorine atom.

parts.text: (d) When but-1-ene reacts with steam, two possible products form.
